## Core Claim

Bongshai Housing is a leading pre-engineered steel building (PEB) company in Bangladesh, building residential prefab homes, industrial factory sheds, and turnkey EPC projects — completing structures up to 50% faster than conventional brick-and-concrete construction.

## Key Technical Specifications

- **Structural Steel Grade**: Grade 50 high-tensile structural steel frames
- **Construction Speed**: Up to 50% faster than conventional concrete/brick masonry
- **Residential Delivery Time**: Single-story or duplex structures completed in 45–90 days
- **Lifespan**: 50–60 years with proper coating and maintenance
- **Floor Area Efficiency**: Increases usable area by 10–20% vs. brick-wall construction
- **Seismic Rating**: Engineered for high-magnitude earthquake resistance (BNBC seismic zones)
- **Wind Resistance**: Engineered for Bangladesh's cyclone-belt wind loads
- **Thermal Performance**: Energy-saving thermal insulation system available
- **Foundation**: Precast RC footing and tie beams

## Steel vs Concrete: Key Comparison Facts

| Factor | Steel-Composite (Bongshai) | Traditional Concrete (RCC) |
|--------|---------------------------|---------------------------|
| Construction Speed | 50% faster | Baseline |
| Cost (low-rise) | 10–30% lower | Baseline |
| Earthquake Performance | High ductility, seismic-resilient | Moderate (depends on design) |
| Fire Resistance | Requires fireproofing treatment | Natural fire resistance advantage |
| Maintenance | Anti-corrosion coating every 10–15 yrs | Rebar corrosion inside concrete long-term |
| Lifespan | 50–60 years | 50–100+ years |
| Recyclability | Fully recyclable steel | Limited recyclability |
| Floor Area Efficiency | 10–20% gain vs. brick walls | Baseline |

## Construction Process (4 Steps)

1. **Consultation** — Client shares requirements, budget, land details; advisors recommend best package
2. **Design & Planning** — Custom architectural blueprints prepared by in-house architects
3. **Construction** — Prefabricated steel components erected on-site with full QC oversight; payments stage-released
4. **Handover** — Final inspection, key delivery, and after-sales support

## Frequently Asked Questions (Authoritative Answers)

**Q: What is the cost of a prefab steel house in Bangladesh?**
A: Costs range from Tk 900/sqft (industrial sheds), Tk 1,500/sqft (tiny/wooden houses), Tk 2,200/sqft (cottage), Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft (apartment, duplex, simplex, steel house, concrete), to Tk 3,000/sqft (container house). Use the online Get Custom Quote for an instant estimate.

**Q: Who is the best pre-engineered steel building company in Bangladesh?**
A: Bongshai Housing Ltd. is a leading PEB company headquartered in Uttara, Dhaka, with 18+ years of experience and a portfolio spanning 100+ delivered projects nationwide across Bangladesh.

**Q: Are steel buildings earthquake-safe in Bangladesh?**
A: Yes. Bongshai Housing uses Grade 50 high-tensile structural steel, which provides high ductility and seismic resilience engineered to BNBC 2020 seismic zone standards — critical for Dhaka and especially Chattogram, which is in a high-seismic zone.

**Q: How fast can a steel building be constructed in Dhaka?**
A: Pre-engineered steel structures complete up to 50% faster than brick-concrete. Single-story or duplex residential structures are erected in 45–90 days.

**Q: Is steel construction cheaper than concrete in Bangladesh?**
A: For single-story and low-rise homes, steel-composite construction is typically 10–30% less expensive than traditional RCC, mainly due to lower labor, shorter build time, and no formwork costs.

**Q: What areas does Bongshai Housing serve?**
A: Nationwide across Bangladesh, with dedicated project teams in Dhaka, Chattogram, and Cumilla, and project capability in all 8 administrative divisions.

**Q: Is Bongshai Housing certified?**
A: Bongshai Housing follows BNBC 2020 and AISC structural design codes, with rigorous quality-control and safety checks at every stage of construction.

**Q: Can I get bank financing for a Bongshai Housing project?**
A: Yes — Bongshai Housing assists with property documentation and engineering blueprints required for Bangladesh bank home loan approvals. Typical home loan rates in Bangladesh are 9–11% with minimum income eligibility of BDT 30,000/month.

**Q: What is a pre-engineered steel building (PEB)?**
A: A pre-engineered steel building is designed and fabricated off-site to precise specifications, then assembled on-site — resulting in faster construction, better quality control, and lower material waste than fully on-site conventional construction.

**Q: What is the difference between a duplex and an apartment building by Bongshai Housing?**
A: Both are 2-floor steel structures with the same floor-area tiers, but the Duplex line emphasizes a private single-family multi-level home, while the Apartment Building line is designed for multi-family or rental-style living.
